metas.name: Alps
metas.note: The highest parts of the Alps are in western and central Switzerland. The tallest peaks are on the Italian border in Austria’s panhandle, known for their sharp, dramatic appearance.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Graz Bus
metas.note: Graz´s public transport company is called "Graz Holding". The logo of it can be seen on busses/trams in this region.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Graz Street Signs
metas.note: In Graz you can find green streetsigns with 2 lines.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Innsbruck Street Sign
metas.note: In Innsbruck you can find large streetsigns with a heading and small text on it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Lake of Constance
metas.note: Lake Constance (also known as Bodensee) lies on Austria’s western border. It's easy to recognize by its size, unmatched by other lakes in Austria’s mountain regions.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Linz Street Signs
metas.note: In Linz you can find both blue signs with a unique font and white (red frame) with a coat of arms on them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Red White Pole Tape
metas.note: Poles in Vienna and Innsbruck often have red-and-white tape resembling the Austrian flag. In Vienna, the tape is thinner, usually with two strips per pole.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Salzburg Roadmarking
metas.note: A large white painted square in the middle of the road can be found next to kilometre markers in Salzburg.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Styria Bus
metas.note: Styria´s public transport company is called "RegioBus Steiermark". The logo of it can be seen on busses in this region.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Upper Austria Bus
metas.note: Upper Austria´s public transport company is called "OÖVV". The logo of it can be seen on busses in this region.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vienna Bus
metas.note: Vienna´s public transport company is called "Wiener Linien". The logo of it can be seen on busses in/around the city. (image) NOTE: You can also see "Wiener Linien"/the logo on trams.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vienna Street Signs
metas.note: Vienna street signs are dark blue plaques with a classic white serif font. The number at the beginning shows the district you're in (see map).
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vineyards
metas.note:
Vineyards are limited to the far eastern part of the country.

You can find a very precise map here. Notably, there are a lot of vineyards close to Vienna and around Lake Neusiedl.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vorarlberg Bus Stops
metas.note: Bus stops consisting of neon-yellow poles are found in Vorarlberg.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vorarlberg Kilometer Markers
metas.note: White kilometre markers can be found in Vorarlberg as well as on a road in western Salzburg.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vorarlberg Landbus
metas.note: Vorarlberg´s public transport company is called "Landbus". The logo of it can be seen on busses in this region.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Vorarlberg Pole Markings
metas.note: These yellow and white stripes around poles and signposts are found in Vorarlberg.
